7A  Vocabulary
Description
Students review activities vocabulary from the lesson by doing a crossword
Lesson link
Use this activity at the end of the lesson
Time
10 minutes
Extra material Print out and photocopy the What do you like doing? worksheet – one for each student
Instructions
a Give each student a copy of the ‘What do you like doing?’
worksheet. Explain to SS that the number(s) in brackets after
each clue represents the number of letters in each answer. Tell
SS that they can work individually or in pairs to complete the
crossword. Pre-teach / elicit across and down.
b After SS have finished ask them to compare answers. Review
answers with the class.
Answers

Across
1 sleeping outside in a tent (camping)
3 visiting different countries (travelling)
4 you do this on a bicycle (cycling)
6 spending all my money in the High Street (shopping)
7 you do this on an aeroplane (flying)
10 you do this in water (swimming)

Down
1 talking on the Internet (chatting online)
2 watching a film with lots of other people (going to the cinema)
4 making a meal (cooking)
5 watching films in your house (watching DVDs)
8 you wear your trainers for this (running)
9 enjoying a good book (reading)
